params.body:
A share can now be a document in HTML, not only Markdown: accordions (`details`), inline drawings (`svg`), figures, tables. The hand names the file `.html`; Portal keeps it to what a document needs and nothing that runs.

- **`SafeHtml`**: an allowlist of tags and attributes, parsed with the HTML5 parser (`Dom\HTMLDocument`) so SVG keeps its case-sensitive attributes. Scripts, event handlers, frames, forms, objects, `<use>`, `<image>`, `javascript:` links, `url()` in styles and comments never survive. Images only as `data:` URIs: a remote image would let its host see who reads a share, and when. Applied on the way in and again on render.
- **CSP on every share page**, the second lock: `default-src 'none'`, styles from self and the fonts host, images from self and data, no frames, no forms off-site.
- `format` on a share (`markdown` or `html`), set from the uploaded name; the owner's paste form stays Markdown.
- Reading page: figures, drawings, and the accordion styled as text that behaves (a small bar that turns), no widget.

Tests: `IngestShareTest` gains the HTML case (what stays, what goes, the header). Pint and PHPStan clean; full suite run.

params.title: Shares: a document in HTML, kept to what a document needs
